name: Nova Multi-Agent Core
tag: Five agent hubs that run robots, tune operations and fix support tickets, all from one core.

scenarios.title: Self-repairing support tickets
scenarios.ask: Route our {tickets} weekly support tickets through the Support hub and auto-fix the common ones.
steps: Support hub
Classified {tickets} tickets by product and problem.
Repair agent
Matched {=round(tickets * known / 100)} tickets to known fixes, such as password resets and stuck orders.
Verifier
Confirmed each fix worked by checking the account state afterward.
Escalation
Sent {=tickets - round(tickets * known / 100)} tickets to people with a suggested first step.

result.title: Weekly ticket run
rows: Fix attempted, sent to a person

followups: The Verifier catches it, the change is rolled back where possible, and the ticket goes to a person with a note on what was tried.
How does it learn new fixes?
When staff solve the same issue several times, the hub proposes a new fix recipe. A person approves it before it is used.

scenarios.title: Coordinate warehouse robots
scenarios.ask: Coordinate {robots} picking robots for {orders} orders in a shift.
steps: Robot hub
Assigned orders to {robots} robots by zone and battery level.
Path planner
Planned routes to avoid aisle conflicts. Average trip {=round(4 + 30 / robots, 1)} minutes.
Optimization hub
Batched orders that share shelves so robots pick several at once.
Safety monitor
Paused robots in any aisle where a person scans in.

result.title: Shift plan
rows: Staggered, {=max(1, ceil(robots / 6))} robots at a time

followups: The hub flags it at the start of the shift so you can add pickers or move orders to the next shift.
Does it work with our robots?
It connects through standard robot fleet interfaces. A short integration check confirms your models before go-live.

scenarios.title: Tune a production line
scenarios.ask: Our packaging line runs at {speed} units a minute with {scrap}% scrap. Find better settings.
steps: Data hub
Pulled 30 days of sensor data: temperature, speed, seal pressure and scrap.
Optimization hub
Tested {=round(40 + scrap * 10)} setting combinations on a model of the line.
Advisor
Best result: seal temperature up 4 degrees and speed down 5%, which cut scrap in the model.
Safety check
Confirmed all settings stay inside the machine's rated limits.
followups: Will it change the machine settings itself?
No. It recommends settings and a person applies them. A trial run on one shift is the usual next step.
How accurate is the line model?
It is fit to your last 30 days of data. Treat the gains as an estimate until a trial run confirms them.
